proposals.before: The Burmese chief Mang Dala had been usurped by the Musuo chief; he defeated the Guizhou Mohang, and the Guizhou chief Gong Guyan fled to Menglian.
proposals.after: The Burmese chief Mang Dala had been usurped by the Musuo chief; he defeated the Gui Family of Mohang, and the Gui chief Gong Guyan fled to Menglian.
proposals.reason: 貴家 is the Gui Family (Chinese settlers), not the province Guizhou (貴州); 貴酋 means the Gui chief.

proposals.before: The Burmese chief Mang Dala had been usurped by the Musuo chief; he defeated the Guizhou Mohang; the Guizhou chief Gong Guyan fled to Menglian.
proposals.after: The Burmese chief Mang Dala had been usurped by the Musuo chief; he defeated the Gui Family Mohang; the Gui chief Gong Guyan fled to Menglian.
proposals.reason: Same 貴家/貴酋 mistranslation as Guizhou instead of Gui Family.

proposals.before: In the second month of the thirtieth year the Muslims of Ush rebelled; the Vice Commander-in-Chief stationed there, Such eng, killed himself; the rebels made the petty beg Lai Heimutula their leader and held out behind the walls.
proposals.after: In the second month of the thirtieth year the Muslims of Ush rebelled; the Vice Commander-in-Chief stationed there, Sucheng, killed himself; the rebels made the petty beg Lai Heimutula their leader and held out behind the walls.
proposals.reason: Proper name 素誠 is split as "Such eng" with an erroneous space.

proposals.before: In the second month of the thirtieth year the Muslims of Ush rebelled; the Vice Commander-in-Chief stationed at Ush, Such eng, killed himself; the rebels made the petty beg Lai Heimutula their leader and held out in defense.
proposals.after: In the second month of the thirtieth year the Muslims of Ush rebelled; the Vice Commander-in-Chief stationed at Ush, Sucheng, killed himself; the rebels made the petty beg Lai Heimutula their leader and held out in defense.
proposals.reason: Same erroneous space in "Such eng" for 素誠.

proposals.before: In the eleventh month he reached Wanding and advanced against Mohang; the rebels fled. He left Coordinator Zhulun'e and Surveillance Commissioner Yang Zhongying to hold the place, then led more than ten thousand men across the Xibo River to attack Manjie.
proposals.after: In the eleventh month he reached Wanding and advanced against Mohang; the rebels fled. He left Coordinator Zhulun'e and Surveillance Commissioner Yang Chongying to hold the place, then led more than ten thousand men across the Xibo River to attack Manjie.
proposals.reason: 楊重英 is the same Chongying (重英) treated earlier; Zhongying is an inconsistent romanization.

proposals.before: Before the edict arrived, in the first month of the thirty-third year the rebels attacked Mohang; Vice Commander-in-Chief Zhulun'e's army collapsed and he killed himself, and Yang Zhongying was seized and taken away.
proposals.after: Before the edict arrived, in the first month of the thirty-third year the rebels attacked Mohang; Vice Commander-in-Chief Zhulun'e's army collapsed and he killed himself, and Yang Chongying was seized and taken away.
proposals.reason: Same inconsistent Zhongying for 重英/楊重英 elsewhere rendered Chongying.
